Method of Attack: In-browser cryptocurrency mining (cryptojacking) without user consent
Abusive mining of cryptocurrencies inside browsers causing high CPU usage
Impacted Systems: Websites loading LiveHelpNow live chat and support widget
Nearly 1,500 sites including retail store chains Crucial and Everlast
Attack Vector: Injection of Coinhive mining script inside JavaScript file of LiveHelpNow widget
Hijacking of domain of EU cookie consent script to deploy Crypto-Loot miner
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Coinhive and Crypto-Loot mining scripts disguised as legitimate scripts
